intro: Elevate every meal with the Magnitude chairs. Their tall backrest and cushioned fabric seat keep you comfortable, while the warm mahogany frame brings timeless elegance to your dining space.

features.title: Stay comfortable through long dinners
features.text: The cushioned polyester fabric seat with soft foam padding keeps you cozy so you can enjoy family meals or conversations without discomfort.

features.title: Tall backrest for supportive posture
features.text: A high reinforced backrest supports your spine, helping you sit with ease through both quick breakfasts and leisurely dinners.

features.title: Strong solid wood construction
features.text: Crafted from sturdy rubberwood in a rich mahogany finish, the chairs give you reliable durability along with a refined look.

features.title: Warm mahogany elegance
features.text: The Indian mahogany shade blends beautifully with dining tables and interiors, adding depth and sophistication to your space.

features.title: Practical and versatile design
features.text: Clean lines and compact form ensure the chairs fit well in any dining setup while balancing style and everyday utility.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
